units.source_text: 他把麦秸做的草帽压低，遮住眼睛，像被人赶出来似的跑到了外面。

en.t: He pulled the straw hat made of wheat stalks low over his eyes and ran outside as if he had been driven out.

units.source_text: 思考也好，判断也好，在干渴面前，都不过是落到滚烫额头上的一片雪花而已。

en.t: Thought and judgment alike were, in the face of thirst, no more than a single snowflake falling on a burning forehead.

units.source_text: 如果说十杯水是糖的话，那么一杯水就等于鞭子了。

en.t: If ten cups of water were sugar, then one cup of water was the same as a whip.
